email_action_tokens_one_active_per_regis.name: email_action_tokens_one_active_per_registration_purpose
email_action_tokens_one_active_per_regis.where: "used_at" IS NULL AND "invalidated_at" IS NULL AND "registration_id" IS NOT NULL

email_action_tokens_one_active_per_parti.name: email_action_tokens_one_active_per_participant_purpose
email_action_tokens_one_active_per_parti.where: "used_at" IS NULL AND "invalidated_at" IS NULL AND "registration_id" IS NULL

events_capacity_and_declaration_are_inte.name: events_capacity_and_declaration_are_internal_only
events_capacity_and_declaration_are_inte.value: ("events"."registration_mode" = 'INTERNAL') OR ("events"."capacity" IS NULL AND "events"."declaration_document_id" IS NULL)

events_external_fields_external_only.name: events_external_fields_external_only
events_external_fields_external_only.value:
("events"."registration_mode" = 'EXTERNAL' AND "events"."external_registration_url" LIKE 'https://%')
          OR ("events"."registration_mode" <> 'EXTERNAL' AND "events"."external_registration_url" IS NULL AND "events"."external_provider" IS NULL)

events_race_start_within_event.name: events_race_start_within_event
events_race_start_within_event.value:
"events"."race_starts_at" IS NULL
          OR ("events"."race_starts_at" >= "events"."starts_at"
              AND ("events"."ends_at" IS NULL OR "events"."race_starts_at" <= "events"."ends_at"))

events_coordinates_in_range.name: events_coordinates_in_range
events_coordinates_in_range.value:
("events"."latitude" IS NULL OR ("events"."latitude" >= -90 AND "events"."latitude" <= 90))
          AND ("events"."longitude" IS NULL OR ("events"."longitude" >= -180 AND "events"."longitude" <= 180))

events_non_negative_measurements.name: events_non_negative_measurements
events_non_negative_measurements.value:
("events"."distance_meters" IS NULL OR "events"."distance_meters" >= 0)
          AND ("events"."elevation_gain_meters" IS NULL OR "events"."elevation_gain_meters" >= 0)

events_registration_window_ordered.name: events_registration_window_ordered
events_registration_window_ordered.value:
"events"."registration_opens_at" IS NULL OR "events"."registration_closes_at" IS NULL
          OR "events"."registration_closes_at" >= "events"."registration_opens_at"
